title: Adam Mead - VALUEx BRK 2026
description:
60 Years of Berkshire by the Numbers 
The author of The Complete Financial History of Berkshire Hathaway on the data: more equity capital added in the last 5 years than in Berkshire's first 52, and the pivotal Gen Re deal at 3x book.

See the full stream of the event here: https://youtube.com/live/V3V7bqLGP9o
summary: The speaker argues that Berkshire Hathaway's historical success is driven by the compounding of operating earnings, which contributed 58% of total capital growth, alongside an exceptional insurance business that generated underwriting earnings in most years. He further suggests that the company could replicate its 1965 share count by 2025 if it executes significant share repurchases over the next five years, potentially reaching this milestone by Warren Buffett's 100th birthday.
